tests.details: Validated AsiSafetySync and AsiNetworkSync POUs with bound registers %R970..%R977, %M226..%M227.
Asserted LadderForbiddenError on ladder contacts, coils, rungs, and mnemonics.
Verified 167 kbit/s APM pulse modulation (T_bit=6.0us), jitter boundaries, and noise limits.
Verified 5ms standard cycle for 31 slaves and 10ms split-phase cycle for 62 A/B slaves.
Verified deterministic 8x4-bit dynamic sequence tables for E-stop, Light Curtain, and Gate Interlock.
Asserted < 40ms fail-safe trip on static zero code (0x00), sequence mismatch, and step timeout.
Verified transient discrepancy tolerance (50ms <= 100ms) and discrepancy trip (> 100ms).
Verified %R970..%R977 bindings, PV/SV scaling (45.6->456), and 0xA101 trip (%M227=TRUE, %M226=FALSE).
Simulated closed-loop scan cycle, tripped E-stop, and recovered cleanly via operator reset handshake.
